items.title: Pierre Merlin Interview, 1961-08-14
items.q: It's the band of Moglis Jospin, which was the trombone of Luther

ctx.x: It's the band of Moglis Jospin, which was the trombone of Luther, with Rabanide, Claude Rabanide, and Pierre Atlan at the clarinet, and one man at the piano, Martin Morel. The rhythm section is very changing. I can't say a name because it's never the same. Yes, I see. But we'll try to do the same kind of music. And we had opportunities to play once with Bechet and twice or three times with Nicolas or other people. I remember we played two times with an American Negro singer, Billy Poole, who sings very well in…
How old? I think about 23. I'm not sure.
